review_scope: Chinese target ranks 51-100 plus the supplemental polyphonic regression card 行

issue_categories.description: Anchor scenes were revised to reuse the actual component image or visual-form mnemonic instead of floating in an unrelated generic setting. Counts overlap other categories.
Overlays were tightened into concrete anchor-word micro-scenes, with clearer agency, lexical meaning, or full-word context.
Neutral-tone behavior, citation-versus-surface tone, and common 一 sandhi were made explicit where the original prose could mislead.
Multi-reading bridges were rebuilt so that one scene orders genuinely different words while clearly preserving each word-specific meaning and tone.
Simplified/traditional relationships were clarified for 现／現, 后／後, 只／隻, 发／發／髮, and 妈／媽.
Authentic sound-bearing components were described as evidence-backed syllable or rhyme relationships without implying an invented exact modern-reading derivation.
The strained English call “zo!” for zǒu was removed and the proposal strategy changed to a vivid 走路 word anchor.

Audited every reading by strategy. All three integrated cues—HUH/hé, ting/tīng, and tie/tài—have an explicit phonetically close hook plus tone path. The 58 word-anchor readings use exact supporting vocabulary and do not claim that a picture independently retrieves the syllable; both phonetic-component readings remain source-backed.

concrete_fixes.before: A walker calls ‘zo!’ as the 走路 path drops into a valley and climbs out.
concrete_fixes.after: 走路 is now explicitly the supporting word for zǒu; the earth path is limited to showing the third-tone contour and does not pretend to supply the syllable. Strategy changed from integrated_sound_cue to word_anchor.

concrete_fixes.before: A strand of 头发 falls, and the overlay treats the anchor as a fully falling fà.
concrete_fixes.after: The revision distinguishes 發 fā from 髮 fà and states that dictionary fà is commonly realized as light fa in 头发（tóu fa）.

concrete_fixes.before: Three generic hand actions represented zhe, zháo, and zhuó without reusing the semantic scene.
concrete_fixes.after: One sheep-and-watching-eye film now moves through ongoing 着, worried 着急, and task-starting 着手, preserving all three lexical roles.

concrete_fixes.before: A spotlight contrasted the readings but omitted the traditional classifier distinction.
concrete_fixes.after: The single-mouth scene now contrasts 只是 zhǐ with animal classifier 只 zhī and records that only the classifier becomes 隻 in traditional writing.

concrete_fixes.before: A generic theater curtain represented 后来 while ignoring the semantic queen scene and the 後 variant.
concrete_fixes.after: The queen completes her command before a courtier arrives 后来, with an explicit note that the later sense is 後來 in traditional writing.

concrete_fixes.before: The overlay displayed 一点 as yī diǎn without noting its ordinary spoken sandhi.
concrete_fixes.after: It preserves citation yī diǎn and explains that 一 surfaces as yì before third-tone diǎn in ordinary speech.

concrete_fixes.before: The overlay displayed 一定 as yī dìng without noting its ordinary spoken sandhi.
concrete_fixes.after: It preserves citation yī dìng and explains that 一 surfaces as yí before fourth-tone dìng in ordinary speech.

concrete_fixes.before: 见／見 was said to leave an unspecified sound echo inside 现.
concrete_fixes.after: The overlay calls 见／見 the source-backed sound-bearing component, states the defensible shared -iàn rhyme, and lets 现在 fix modern xiàn and its falling tone.

concrete_fixes.before: The prose made Mama appear to transform dipping mǎ into level mā.
concrete_fixes.after: 马／馬 now preserves the ma syllable family while 妈妈（mā ma） independently fixes first-tone mā and the following neutral ma.

concrete_fixes.before: A generic peace table and stove contrasted hé and huo but barely reused the grain-and-mouth scene.
concrete_fixes.after: The 和平 scene now adds a rising “HUH?”, a defensibly close hook for rising hé, and is reclassified integrated_sound_cue. 暖和 remains an honest supporting word for light neutral huo.

concrete_fixes.before: The route scene paired rising motion with xíng and háng without stating that the vocabulary—not the picture—carries the syllables.
concrete_fixes.after: 行动 and 银行 are explicitly identified as supporting words for xíng and háng; the two uphill movements encode only their shared rising tone and word-specific stations.
